rationale: A unanimous opinion is most likely assigned to and kept by the Chief Justice, framing a narrow holding that Title III creates a cause of action but does not unmistakably displace FSIA’s jurisdictional/immunity framework (Verlinden, Amerada Hess, Halkbank). Some risk of separate concurrences remains—especially from textualists/originalists—to emphasize clear-statement/implied-repeal principles or to flag foreign-relations consequences while joining the judgment.
